- Each ID starts with the literal prefix `record`.
- The numeric part is zero-padded to 6 digits.
- IDs appear sequentially from:

```text
record000001
```

through:

```text
record005200
```

So the ID format is effectively:

```text
record + 6-digit zero-padded number
```

or, in a printf-style

followup.answer:
The last record ID is now:

```text
record005260
```

The records have a uniform, predictable structure:

```text
record000001: alpha beta gamma delta epsilon zeta eta theta.
```
